newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end mixed, nearbys months up.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end mixed, nearbys months up.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures closed mixed on Tuesday, as nearby months gained on speculative buying caused by the freighter accident in New Orleans, traders said.
Prices ranged from 130 yen lower to 200 yen higher, with benchmark January 1998 contract down 40 yen at 13,860 yen per tonne. Daily volume was 58,042 lots.

Nearby months received buying from local investors, who assumed a freighter accident along the Mississippi River last Saturday would cause delayed shipments of the U.S. corn, traders said. The Port of New Orleans is the key export gateway of U.S. grains to the world market.
